=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:7441-7455 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: code_ref_run_eligible() accepts any run with status "in_progress" as a stalled child before it checks any job or step, so a healthy child still running on another in-scope branch can become the code-ref candidate and retarget the heal. The test at tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py:12128-12129 codifies this behaviour.
  WHY: The issue asks for the run "whose step failed or stalled", and a run that is still running and has no failed conclusion is neither. Severity: minimax, luna and glm say MAJOR, gemini gave none, so the highest is used. The cited lines differ (gemini 7453-7455, the others 7441-7444 or 7443), but all point to the same function and the same test lines. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 looked at this finding from pass 1 and did not adopt it: it argues that an in_progress child after the parent gate failed is exactly the incident's stalled case.
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:10114-10150 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: _cmd_code_ref loads cached `run-<id>.json` docs by filename from --linked-dir (`${RUNTIME_DIR}/linked_runs/`). It never checks that `run_doc.get("id")` equals the requested `run_id`, and code_ref_run_eligible does not check `id` either. A doc that _heal_fetch_linked_runs skipped as run_malformed (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh lines 2801-2808), which is left on disk and missing from fetched_ids.txt, can therefore become the retarget candidate and report the wrong run_id.
  WHY: This contradicts the agents.d claim of "same identity and repository checks as `_heal_fetch_linked_runs`" and the new fail-closed --lookup-failed rule. The trigger is narrow, and the suggested fix is about 3 lines (set lookup_failed = True and continue when the id does not match). Severity: sonnet, minimax and glm say NIT, gemini gave none.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "When P1 is off, make one `GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>` per linked or issue-linked run, at most 3."
  expected_change_site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh::_heal_code_ref_route (P1-off arm, evidence_api_dir/code_ref_api_dir assignment) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py::code_ref_requests / _cmd_code_ref (issue-linked run loader)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: With P1 off, _heal_code_ref_route gets ids only from log-linked runs (scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh:3763-3773). evidence_api_dir/code_ref_api_dir is set only when EVIDENCE_PACK_ENABLED=true (lines 3760-3762). _cmd_code_ref loads issue-linked runs only from that directory (scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:10151-10169), so an issue-linked-only child is never looked up or considered. The narrowing is documented in the code comment and in agents.d. A prior editor round deferred it because issue-linked ids are only known from the P1 runs listing, which would need an extra call beyond the 3-GET budget. Severity: anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 says NIT and agrees with the deferral; gemini, minimax, luna and glm say MAJOR, and glm adds "treat as accepted residual unless the editor re-opens it".
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:_cmd_code_ref (related: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh, _heal_fetch_linked_runs, lines 2801-2808) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: The linked/fetched directory loop appends `(run_doc, jobs_doc)` without checking `run_doc.get("id")`, and code_ref_run_eligible() does not check `id` either. A doc that _heal_fetch_linked_runs skipped as run_malformed stays on disk outside fetched_ids.txt. It can still drive a retarget with a mismatched run_id, and `_code_ref_cached_ids` counts it as cached, so it is never re-fetched.
  WHY: A doc that already failed identity validation picks the heal's target branch instead of setting lookup_failed. This is unlikely, since GitHub rarely returns a mismatched id. The empty-file case is handled because gh_api_json_to_file truncates on failure (gh_helpers.sh:1487).
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py:_cmd_code_ref, right after `run_doc, malformed = _code_ref_load(...)` | HARDENING_RISK_SCORE=1
  PROBLEM: A cached run doc is used without checking that its id matches the requested run id.
  WHY: Suggested fix: if run_doc is not None and (not isinstance(run_doc, dict) or run_doc.get("id") != int(run_id)), set lookup_failed = True and continue (about 3 lines).
- TASK_GAP | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  Requirement: "When P1 is off, make one `GET repos/<repo>/actions/runs/<id>` per linked or issue-linked run, at most 3."
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh::_heal_code_ref_route (the P1-off `elif` arm) and scripts/workflow_failure_heal.py::code_ref_requests
  Evidence of absence: In the P1-off arm, code_ref_requests receives only log texts, and code_ref_api_dir is set only when EVIDENCE_PACK_ENABLED=true, so no issue-linked run is considered. The narrowing is documented and the deferral reasoning holds (it would need a listing call outside the 3-GET budget). Recorded as not a defect in the last-run diff.
- NOTES (not findings, 4 related items): (1) Did not adopt openai_gpt-6-luna's pass-1 "in_progress counts as stalled" finding, because an in_progress child after the parent gate failed is the incident's stalled case. The rule was narrowed to in_progress only, and a retarget still requires frozen scope, a different branch, an accepted probe and an existing branch. (2) The pre-push gate failure in tests/test_workflow_checkout_integration_ref_audit.py (line 62 allowlist) is not reached by this diff. (3) The copilot-pull-request-reviewer `custom_instructions_too_large` HTTP 422 is reviewer infrastructure. (4) Verified as correct in the last run: mkdir failure → partial/helper_failed; an identity-check failure passes `--lookup-failed`; lookup_failed blocks retarget but keeps the `Code ran from` line; `_code_ref_run_path` strips `@ref`; the P1-off intake test matches the flow.
=== END FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
